contact_uv_repair.authored_assumption: Companion hidden rear-contact surfaces use the measured dominant-channel source palette. Dark neutral fringe within one ring of the part interface is authored as that palette; body dominant-color fringe is mapped to adjacent ivory/charcoal material. Blender -Y is authored front and +Y back; front half/front-facing surfaces and light details are protected. This is explicit local unseen-surface authoring, not inferred ground truth. Explicit normalized boxes additionally authorize light neutral rear-head contact marks to the part palette and light neutral vacant-shoulder contact marks to charcoal. These exceptions apply only inside the existing one-ring contact band; detached-part front half/front-facing faces remain protected.

contact_uv_repair.protection: Detached-part front half/front-facing surfaces stay protected; light details stay protected except explicit bounded override regions inside the contact band
